summary: Iteration 27 focused test round: automatic Evidence Pack on full-project resolution + PDF 'REMEDIATION DETAILS - WORK CARRIED OUT' heading. New /app/backend/tests/test_iter27_auto_pack.py — 11/11 passed. iter26 regression /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_dropbox_folders.py — 15/15 passed. All 7 requirements verified end-to-end against the live preview backend (https://field-evidence-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com) with live Dropbox metadata/download via storage.client().files_get_metadata(id).path_display and files_download(id) after `await dropbox_link.load_dropbox()`. (1) Two-NC project (NC1 -> Ian, NC2 reassigned to Sam via POST /api/ncs/{id}/assign): approve ONLY NC1 (POST /api/ncs/{id}/review action=approve) -> db.auto_packs has ZERO rows for pid; approve NC2 -> exactly ONE row _id=`{pid}:1`, status='saved', cycle=1, path starts 'dbx:', resolved Dropbox path matches `/remedialflow/{folder}/{Ref}/{Ref}_Evidence_Pack_{YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS}_v1-[0-9a-f]{6}.zip`, size>2KB, files>=2; downloaded ZIP (via storage client files_download) contains >=2 .pdf entries (one per NC) and no exceptions. (2) Concurrency: separate project, same approve-NC2 call fired 6-way in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor; all 6 returned 200; still exactly ONE auto_packs row for `{pid}:1` with status='saved' (deterministic _id + DuplicateKeyError guard in queue_auto_pack holds under parallel recomputes). (3) Reopen: POST /api/ncs/{nc1}/review action=trustmark_reject (allowed only when nc.status=='approved'; sets status='rejected', pushes reopen_history, clears resolved) -> approve NC1 again -> auto_packs _id=`{pid}:2` created with cycle=2, status='saved', distinct Dropbox path with _v2-[0-9a-f]{6}.zip suffix; the cycle-1 Dropbox file is still readable (append-only); exactly 2 rows total for the project. (4) Failure path: inserted a synthetic auto_packs row cycle=99 for a resolved project, then from a *subprocess* ran server.run_auto_pack(key) after calling storage.set_refresh(None) in that process only — storage.dropbox_ready went False and the job wrote status='failed' + error 'Dropbox is not connected' + no 'dbx:' path + emitted audit event='export.auto_pack_failed'. db.secure_settings.dropbox was NEVER modified. Then POST /api/projects/{pid}/evidence-packs/retry on the live backend (where Dropbox IS connected) flipped the SAME row to status='saved' with a 'dbx:' path. (5) RBAC: installer GET /api/projects/{pid}/evidence-packs -> 403; installer POST /api/projects/{pid}/evidence-packs/retry -> 403; employee GET returns [cycle 2, cycle 1] with every item status='saved' and no leaked `_id`. (6) PDF content check (opened every PDF inside the auto-generated ZIP with PyMuPDF): every page contains the exact heading 'REMEDIATION DETAILS - WORK CARRIED OUT'; the heading appears BEFORE 'REMEDIATION PHOTOGRAPHS' (string index comparison); for the NC where PUT /api/ncs/{id}/export-note was called the recorded note text is rendered verbatim ('Replaced cable with 2.5mm T&E, tested RCD trip 28ms.'); for the NC with no note the text is 'No details recorded.' — no invented wording. The legacy heading 'REMEDIATION NOTE' is NOT present in any PDF. (7) Manual export regression: GET /api/export/link?project_id=... as employee -> 200, the signed /api/export/project/{pid}.zip streams a valid ZIP (>2 KB, contains PDFs), AND db.dropbox_exports grew by one entry (background save_export_copy still runs and lands under /remedialflow/{folder}/{Ref}/..._Evidence_Pack_..._{6hex}.zip — iter26 regression still 100%). Zero Dropbox delete/move operations; secure_settings untouched; no 5xx responses observed.
action_items: No fixes required. Automatic evidence pack and new PDF 'REMEDIATION DETAILS - WORK CARRIED OUT' heading are implemented correctly and behave exactly per spec, including the duplicate-safe deterministic _id='{pid}:{cycle}', the staff-only list/retry endpoints, the failure->retry recovery path, and the append-only Dropbox layout for cycle 2+ files.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:84-118 recompute_project(): status becomes 'completed' only when every NC is in DONE; completion_history is appended ONLY on the transition from a non-completed state (guard on proj.status not in ('completed','trustmark_resolved')) which prevents repeat enqueues on idempotent approves; the cycle passed to queue_auto_pack is len(upd['completion_history']) so simultaneous callers either both see the SAME cycle (-> DuplicateKeyError no-op) or one sees the appended value — verified by the 6-way concurrent approve test which still produced exactly 1 row.

/app/backend/server.py:1467-1474 queue_auto_pack(): deterministic _id='{pid}:{cycle}' + DuplicateKeyError catch is the right primitive for de-duplication; the follow-up asyncio.create_task(run_auto_pack(...)) runs only on first insert so parallel triggers do not spawn parallel uploads.

/app/backend/server.py:1477-1505 run_auto_pack(): claim is a single find_one_and_update that only accepts 'pending'/'failed' or stale 'running' (>30 min) — exactly-once semantics within a cycle, with a stale-worker fallback so a crashed task is retried on the 30-minute boundary or at startup. Writes 'saved' with path/size/files and 'failed' with error (<=200 chars) + audit entries both ways. On skip (project reopened before worker started) it writes status='skipped' with error 'Project no longer fully resolved' and no Dropbox call — correct.

/app/backend/server.py:1522-1525 retry_pending_packs() is wired to startup via lifespan (server restarts auto-retry pending/failed/running) — this is the backend-startup safety net required by the spec.

/app/backend/server.py:1143-1156 review() trustmark_reject: enforces nc.status=='approved' precondition; pushes a reopen_history entry; the subsequent recompute_project clears proj.resolved and brings status back to in_progress — so a second approval cycle starts cleanly with len(completion_history)==2.

/app/backend/evidence_pack.py:144-151 nc_pdf(): writes exactly the required heading 'REMEDIATION DETAILS - WORK CARRIED OUT' immediately before the remediation photographs block, falls back to 'No details recorded.' when nc.export_note is empty, and never emits the legacy 'REMEDIATION NOTE' heading — matches spec verbatim.

/app/backend/server.py:969-975 PUT /api/ncs/{id}/export-note trims and clamps to 600 chars (via ExportNoteIn.Field(max_length=600)); strict staff dependency; writes to ncs.export_note which the next evidence pack picks up directly — no stale cache.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://field-evidence-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com python3 -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter27_auto_pack.py -v -n 0 (serial required — module-level STATE dict shares pid/cycle paths across classes A->B->D->F). pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 --dist loadscope which splits classes across workers and breaks STATE sharing; always pass `-n 0`. The failure-path test spawns a subprocess that calls server.run_auto_pack(key) after storage.set_refresh(None) — this only mutates the SUBPROCESS's in-memory HybridStorage instance; secure_settings in Mongo is NEVER touched. PDF introspection uses PyMuPDF (`pymupdf.open(stream=..., filetype='pdf')`). Audit entries use field 'event' (not 'action'). To find the latest auto_packs row for a project: _mongo.auto_packs.find({'project_id': pid}).sort('cycle', -1). To resolve a 'dbx:<id>' path: use the dbx_get_path helper (uses dropbox_link.load_dropbox + storage.client().files_get_metadata). The ZIP for a saved pack is downloadable with storage.get(path) / files_download(id).
rca_of_issue: No RCA — all acceptance criteria passed. Single interim failure during authoring was a test-side bug (queried audit collection with key 'action' instead of actual 'event' field defined in core.py:229); fixed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter27_auto_pack.py and re-ran green.
